summary: The change strengthens the posture. A write delegation now requires a digest-bound passing per-task grill; input_sha256 binds to the exact task contract (task_digest), so an edited/stale contract invalidates the grill (fail-closed, like require_grill). record_grill's --task carries a path-traversal guard (Path(task).name != task rejects ../ and separators). The board PR-link render validates the http(s) scheme before emitting an anchor (non-http -> escaped span, blocking javascript:/data: URIs), escapes all interpolated content, and sets rel=noopener noreferrer on external links.
